message:
## Brief

**Goal:** On the Northside Physio clinic prototype, rename "Customers" to "Clients". Nothing else changes.

**Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only prototype in the folder. It is plain HTML, so I will serve it locally with the loop's own server. It has no `dev` or `start` script.

**Reference to copy:** none. The copy-reference step will be skipped.

**Design rules and step skills:** there is no `CLAUDE.md` in the folder. I found no `product-design` or `design-review` skill. The run will use the loop's built-in make-changes and design-check rules.

**Start checks:**
- A browser for screenshots: found (Google Chrome).
- Node 22 or newer: Node v25.9.0.
- The prototype exists: yes.

**Stop fact:** The one request below is done and swept. No screen that the note does not name has changed or broken. The prototype's link opens (HTTP 200).

**Where the result goes:** a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed, committed or sent.

## Request list

| # | Note | Screen | Where | How I will prove it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rename "Customers" to "Clients" | Clients | everywhere | "Customers" no longer appears on any screen or in the code, and the title of the Clients screen reads "Clients" |

I found "Customers" once, as the page title on the Clients screen (line 87). The nav link already says "Clients".

Your words "nothing else" mean:
- No other text, spacing, colour or behaviour changes.
- I will not fix anything I notice on the way. Anything I notice is only listed under "Broken before the run" in the handover. The Invoices filter has no empty state, and "New appointment" on Today does nothing.

## Questions

1. **Is the request list right, or is anything missing?** Default: it is right as written. Notes you send later still join this run.
2. **Does "everywhere" fit?** It names a kind of thing (a name), so I marked it everywhere: every place "Customers" appears, in the code and on every screen. I found only the one. Default: everywhere. If you want only the Clients screen title, say so.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
